name_reason: Follows fd2_<domain>_<descriptor>. domain=chapter_event_handler; _44 is the per-event handler-table dispatch index 0x44 (meaningful domain ID, confirmed by table base @0x51B91 and entry xref @0x51CA1; 0x44 != self address 0x35a48 nor any data address, so not an address residue); _ch28 is chapter 28 (valid chapter ID 01-30); dialog_with_state is the category descriptor. purpose: Chapter 28 turn-FF sentinel scene handler (dispatch idx 0x44): show dialog page 4, play one chapter-portrait white-flash cutscene, show dialog page 6, then consume the tile-event slot so the scene never re-fires.
logic_summary: No-arg-using handler (arg ignored). Calls fd2_display_dialog_scene(current_chapter_text, page=4, 0xA0000,0x140,0xCD,0x4C,0x4A,0x13,1); fd2_cinematic_chapter_portrait_dump_with_white_flash(0xE,7,2) (tile (0xE,7), chapter id 2); fd2_display_dialog_scene(...page=6...); finally MOV EAX,[tile_event_consumed_flags]; byte[EAX+0x12]=1 to consume slot 0x12. The two dialog pages bracket the portrait reveal; the consume store is the only state mutation. Single basic-block straight-line (cyclomatic 1). Stack frame 0x28 via __CHK stack-probe prologue (no source semantics). The final consume store at 0x35AAE is a Class-3 shared tail (alt_66) borrowed by fd2_chapter_event_handler_49__ch29_dragon_down_1; binary size optimisation, functionally-exact source is the straight-line three-call sequence + byte store.
